stories.title: SpaceX 人工智能数据中心的 326 万美元收入将回馈孟菲斯市 / $3.26 million in SpaceX AI data center revenue will be pumped back into the City of Memphis

sources.title: SpaceX 人工智能数据中心的 326 万美元收入将回馈孟菲斯市 / $3.26 million in SpaceX AI data center revenue will be pumped back into the City of Memphis
sources.title_zh: SpaceX 人工智能数据中心的 326 万美元收入将回馈孟菲斯市
sources.title_en: $3.26 million in SpaceX AI data center revenue will be pumped back into the City of Memphis
sources.title_original: $3.26 million in SpaceX AI data center revenue will be pumped back into the City of Memphis
sources.summary: The City of Memphis is making its first major investment, almost $3.3 million, through the Community Benefit Ordinance. The fund was set up to use a portion of the tax generated by SpaceX AI's Colossus 1 facility for the benefit of residents, with the first $2 million allocated for a new home repair assistance program.
sources.summary_zh: 孟菲斯市正在通过《社区福利条例》进行第一笔重大投资，投资金额近 330 万美元。该基金的设立目的是使用 SpaceX AI 的 Colossus 1 设施产生的部分税收来造福居民，其中首笔 200 万美元用于新的家庭维修援助计划。

stories.title: Nvidia 表示，假设它预测了 Vera 开发过程中的代理时刻是“荒谬的” / Nvidia says it’s ‘absurd’ to assume it predicted the agentic moment during Vera’s development

sources.title: Nvidia 表示，假设它预测了 Vera 开发过程中的代理时刻是“荒谬的” / Nvidia says it’s ‘absurd’ to assume it predicted the agentic moment during Vera’s development
sources.title_zh: Nvidia 表示，假设它预测了 Vera 开发过程中的代理时刻是“荒谬的”
sources.title_en: Nvidia says it’s ‘absurd’ to assume it predicted the agentic moment during Vera’s development
sources.title_original: Nvidia says it’s ‘absurd’ to assume it predicted the agentic moment during Vera’s development
sources.summary: AMD has criticized Nvidia, and to a lesser extent Arm, for claims about creating a CPU designed for agentic AI. Nvidia is pushing back on that characterization, instead saying Vera was designed with “base principles, product intuition, and oftentimes simple allegorical laws of computer science” in a recent interview with Tom’s Hardware.
sources.summary_zh: AMD 批评 Nvidia 以及较小程度上的 Arm 声称创建专为代理 AI 设计的 CPU。 Nvidia 反驳了这种说法，在最近接受 Tom's Hardware 采访时表示，Vera 的设计遵循“基本原则、产品直觉，以及通常简单的计算机科学寓言定律”。

stories.title: Nvidia 营收达到 1,158 亿美元，Vera Rubin 季度收入再创新高 200 亿美元 / Nvidia's revenue hits $115.8 billion as Vera Rubin generates $20 billion in another record-setting quarter

sources.title: Nvidia 营收达到 1,158 亿美元，Vera Rubin 季度收入再创新高 200 亿美元 / Nvidia's revenue hits $115.8 billion as Vera Rubin generates $20 billion in another record-setting quarter
sources.title_zh: Nvidia 营收达到 1,158 亿美元，Vera Rubin 季度收入再创新高 200 亿美元

sources.title_original: Nvidia's revenue hits $115.8 billion as Vera Rubin generates $20 billion in another record-setting quarter
sources.summary: Nvidia's quarterly revenue surged to $115.8 billion as Vera Rubin achieved a record $20 billion debut, while total commitments to suppliers and customers climbed to $540 billion and rising costs prompted a revised pricing strategy for FY2028.
sources.summary_zh: 随着维拉·鲁宾 (Vera Rubin) 首次亮相创下 200 亿美元创纪录的成绩，Nvidia 的季度收入飙升至 1158 亿美元，而对供应商和客户的总承诺攀升至 5400 亿美元，成本上升促使其修改了 2028 财年的定价策略。

sources.summary: According to a new report, slowing demand for consumer electronics and diverging production requirements for consumer and enterprise NAND have resulted in declining spot prices for consumer-grade flash memory. Those trends may result in unexpected but welcome relief for consumers.
sources.summary_zh: 根据一份新报告，消费电子产品需求放缓以及消费者和企业 NAND 生产需求的差异导致消费级闪存现货价格下降。这些趋势可能会给消费者带来意想不到但受欢迎的缓解。
